messages.subject: Question of R-INLA Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed()
parts:
Hello everyone! 
I'm trying to reproduce the results of the application of prediction of the PM10 concentration in Piemonte region. This application is illustrated in Chapter 7 section 7.2 in the book "Blangiardo, M., & Cameletti, M. (2015). Spatial and spatio-temporal Bayesian models with R-INLA. John Wiley & Sons". However using the R codes assocaited (avelaible in http://www.statistica.it/marta/stbook/Chapter7.R ) to this application, I reviewed the output but I did not understand where is the problem. I attached the output.  

Do you have any suggestion?

Thanks by your attention.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Question of R-INLA Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed()
parts:
I guess you're out of memory. 

please update to the most recent testing version

try to reduce the number of threads,

inla(...., num.threads="2:1", control.inla=list(strategy="adaptive"))
